name: Rayyan Mandi Mankhool,bur dubai
address: Sheikh Sabah Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah St - Al Raffa - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Cuisine with class! We have the best Mandi in town

reviews.author: Chester Singian
reviews.text:
We visited Rayyan’s Bur Dubai on October 18, and what a treat it was! Our Pakistani friend Abdul brought us here for a welcome dinner, and it turned out to be such a wonderful experience. If you’re looking for delicious mandi in Dubai, this place is a must-try!

The place was very busy, but all the staff were incredibly accommodating and efficient. We only waited a few minutes to be seated, and we even got a great spot!The turnaround time was fast despite the crowd. There’s also plenty of parking space, and it’s within walking distance of hotels like Citymax and Four Points by Sheraton, which is a big plus. Wi-Fi is also available, making it even more convenient for diners.

Now, let’s talk about the food!🤤 The appetizers were really good, and the mutton soup was top-tier,especially with a generous squeeze of lemon. They also serve unlimited onions, which is a nice touch!

The rice was absolutely delicious, especially when paired with the fried onions, tomato-vinegar sauce or salsa, and a sprinkle of chili flakes. That combination mixed into the rice was just  chef’s kiss. The chicken was incredibly tender, juicy, and flavorful. You can really tell it has been marinated for hours. I loved the potatoes, too!

And the best part? This is the best mandi I’ve tried so far! Everything was so satisfying, and even the little sweet balls reminded me of carioca back home in the Philippines. Such a lovely way to end the meal!!!

What makes the experience even better is the great food quality at very affordable prices.You really get excellent value for your money!!!

Overall, it was an amazing dining experience, from the food to the service. Highly recommended for anyone craving delicious, flavorful mandi without breaking the bank. Definitely a place worth visiting!⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to know you enjoyed our mandi, delicious food, and friendly service. Your appreciation means a lot to our team. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

reviews.author: Local Guide & Explorer
reviews.text:
Recently, we visited Shams Al Rayyan restaurant for Mandi based on the recommendations of our friends. We chose this place after seeing its high rating and excellent reviews on Google, and it definitely lived up to the expectations!
There were five of us, and we ordered two mutton shoulder spicy Mandi, one mini chicken Mandi Madhbi, Fattoush salad, and Kunafa for takeaway.
Highlights:
Complimentary Items: They serve soup, fried onions (unlimited), raita, tomato green chutney, and lemon as complimentary sides, all of which were excellent.
Taste: The mutton shoulder was superb. As for the rice, I personally found it to be average, but overall, it was a good experience.
Service: The service here is truly outstanding. The Malayali staff member, Mithun, deserves special mention; he served us very quickly and happily, fulfilling all our requests.
Final Items & Incredible Hospitality: After our meal, we asked for Sulaimani black tea and Luqaimat. Mithun brought them as complimentary items with a smile. When we asked for a second round, he brought us two more plates of Luqaimat and five more black teas, all completely free of charge, without any hesitation! Mithun is a genuinely kind person, and the rest of the staff were equally polite and professional.
Ambience & Facilities: The ambience is wonderful. With family rooms and Majlis seating, it is a perfect spot for families. The restaurant can accommodate about 100-150 people at a time with both indoor and outdoor seating. The entire place, including the washing area, is kept perfectly clean.
Bill Details:
Mutton Shoulder: 89 AED each
Mini Chicken Mandi: 20 AED
Fattoush Salad: 15 AED
Kunafa: 15 AED
Additional Rice: 10 AED
Overall, it was a great experience. This is a must-visit place for Mandi lovers. If you are looking for great food paired with top-notch service, you can definitely visit this place. We are very happy with our visit
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you for your detailed and wonderful feedback. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the food, ambience, and overall dining experience, and that our team made your visit special with their hospitality and service.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and are glad we could meet your expectations. We look forward to welcoming you and your friends again soon for another great experience!

reviews.author: Lyne Manuel
reviews.text:
We ordered the Mixed Mandi Family Platter - huge portion, aromatic rice, super tender meat with grilled tomato & lemon on top. Served with shorba (soup), yoghurt, tomato chutney, green chutney, fried onions, fresh salad and lemon wedges. Easily enough for 3-4 people.

For dessert we had Luqaimat - crispy golden balls drizzled with honey & sesame, and Cheese Kunafa - fresh, crispy outside, cheesy inside topped with pistachios, served with sugar syrup.

Ended with Sulaimani - hot black tea with lemon & mint, perfect to digest after Mandi. Refreshing and light.

Service fast, staff friendly, clean family seating, open till 2:30am on Al Mankhool Rd. Best value Mandi spot in Mankhool. Will come back!
Highly recommended!!
Photos: Mandi Platter, Luqaimat, Kunafa, Sulaimani
reviews.owner_reply:

reviews.text: The service was excellent. The staff were very attentive to my needs and served a variety of side dishes, including different sauces and a warm soup. What made the experience unique was that after payment, they applied a lightly scented perfume or oil on my hand, which smelled really nice.

reviews.author: Vijay Thomas Kurien
reviews.text:
I had lunch at Rayyan Mandi, Al Mankhool, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience. I had the quarter chicken mandi along with Sulaimani tea, lamb soup, and dessert, and everything was really delicious. The food was fresh, flavourful, and beautifully prepared.

A special mention to Rajini and Arshad, who were exceptionally polite, warm, courteous, and cordial throughout. Their service was genuinely outstanding, and they made the whole dining experience even more pleasant. Both of them deserve a special appreciation for the way they treated guests with such kindness and professionalism.

The only small concern I had was the amount of food wastage. I personally am not a heavy eater, and I noticed that quite a bit of food can be left over. Given the importance of avoiding unnecessary food wastage, perhaps the restaurant could consider offering smaller portions or allowing customers to choose the quantity according to their appetite. It would be a wonderful initiative, especially at a time when food should be valued and not unnecessarily wasted.

Overall, a fantastic dining experience, excellent food, and truly wonderful service from Rajini and Arshad. I would definitely recommend Rayyan Mandi and look forward to visiting again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your wonderful feedback and recommendation. We’re delighted you enjoyed the food and service. We also appreciate your suggestion regarding portion sizes and food wastage, and we’ll certainly take it into consideration. We look forward to welcoming you again soon.

reviews.author: sharad bishnoi
reviews.text:
Must thank my friend for showing us this gem of a place. Rayyan Mandi at Mankhool is heaven for people who saviour Mandi Biryani, a preparation of Yemeni Cuisine, made with lamb meat.

It’s a very popular restaurant in Dubai, especially for families and it’s always crowded. They serve Mandi Biryani (besides Kebabs and many other things) and let you choose from portion of meat that is to be used in the Biryani. Each serving is made separately and is served at your table, opened right in front of you.

We were in a big group so had to wait for sometime. We loved the place (and food) so much that we visited it again next day.

Go hungry and come and stuffed to brim 😅😅

Mandi Biryani on your mind ? Go Rayyan !!

And did I mention their soup, which they keep serving on request - amazing. Also try their Kunafa Cake. Yummy.
